chapterInfo.content:
55
Deɛ ayɔnkofoɔ ayi no ama
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfoɔ sɛ wɔmfa sankuo nto. Dawid nnweneho dwom.
1Onyankopɔn, yɛ aso tie me mpaebɔ,
na nhunta wo ho mfiri me nkotosrɛ ho.
2Wɛn w’aso ma me, na gye me so.
M’adwene mu nnwane wɔ m’abooboo mu, na mesi apini,
3ɔtamfoɔ nne
ne ɔbɔnefoɔ ahodwan nti.
Na wɔbɔ mmusuo gu me so,
na wɔde abufuo tane me.
4M’akoma pere wɔ me mu,
na owuo ho hu agu me so.
5Suro ne ahopopoɔ aba me so,
na ahoyera akata me so.
6 # Dwom 11.1 Na mese: O, sɛ mewɔ ntaban sɛ aburuburo deɛ ɛ,
anka mɛtu makɔtena baabi.
7Aane, anka mɛdwane makɔ akyirikyiri,
na makɔtena serɛ so.
8Anka mɛyɛ ntɛm madwane mafiri mframa kɛseɛ
ne ahum yi mu.
9 # 2 Sa 17.14 AWURADE, yɛ wɔn basabasa, paepae wɔn tɛkyerɛma mu,
na mahunu amimdie ne aperedie, kuro no mu.
10Awia ne anadwo wɔnam
n’afasuo so twa ho hyia,
na amumuyɛ ne ɔhaw wɔ mu.
11Amammɔsɛm wɔ mu,
na nhyɛsoɔ ne nnaadaa
mpa n’abɔntene so.
12Na ɛnyɛ ɔtamfoɔ na ɔbɔ me ahohora,
ɛno deɛ, anka mɛtie.
Ɛnyɛ deɛ ɔkyiri me na ɔkyerɛ ne ho wɔ me soɔ,
anka mede me ho bɛhunta no.
13 # Dwom 41.9; 2 Sa 15.12 Na wo dasani a me ne wo bɔ soɔ,
me yɔnko ne me manni,
14wo a wo ne me di atirimusɛm dɛdɛ,
na yɛnam yɔɔ kɔ Nyankopɔn fie.
15Ma owuo nto nsi wɔn so,
ma wɔnsiane nkɔ Asamando anikan,
na nsɛmmmɔne wɔ wɔn tenabea ne wɔn mu.
16Me deɛ, mɛsu mafrɛ Onyankopɔn,
na AWURADE abɛgye me.
17Anwummerɛ ne anɔpa ne awigyina
na mɛdwene me tirim na masi apini,
na ɔbɛte me nne.
18Wagye me kra asomdwoeɛ mu,
na wɔammɛn me,
na wɔn a wɔne me anya dɔɔso.
19 # Dwom 102.26 Onyankopɔn bɛte na wabua wɔn.
Na ɔno na ɔte hɔ firi teteete.
Wɔn deɛ, wɔnsakyera,
nanso wɔnsuro Onyankopɔn.
20Ɔtene ne nsa ne nnamfonom so,
wabu n’apam so.
21 # Yer 9.7; Dwom 57.4 N’anomu nsɛm yɛ fekɔɔ sene bɔta,
na ɔko wɔ n’akomam.
Ne nsɛm mu dwo bɛtɛɛ sene ngo,
nanso ɛyɛ mfena a wɔatwe.
22 # 1 Pe 5.7 Dane w’adesoa to AWURADE so,
na ɔbɛsɔ wo mu,
ɔremma ɔteneneeni
ntwe n’anan mu da.
23 # Dwom 102.24 Na wo, Onyankopɔn, wode wɔn
bɛkɔ ɔsɛeɛ amena mu,
mogyapɛfoɔ ne nnaadaafoɔ
renni wɔn nna fa,
na me deɛ, mede me ho meto wo so.

pageProps.chapterText:
Onyankopɔn, yɛ aso tie me mpaebɔ,
na nhunta wo ho mfiri me nkotosrɛ ho.
Wɛn w’aso ma me, na gye me so.
M’adwene mu nnwane wɔ m’abooboo mu, na mesi apini,
ɔtamfoɔ nne
ne ɔbɔnefoɔ ahodwan nti.
Na wɔbɔ mmusuo gu me so,
na wɔde abufuo tane me.
M’akoma pere wɔ me mu,
na owuo ho hu agu me so.
Suro ne ahopopoɔ aba me so,
na ahoyera akata me so.
Na mese: O, sɛ mewɔ ntaban sɛ aburuburo deɛ ɛ,
anka mɛtu makɔtena baabi.
Aane, anka mɛdwane makɔ akyirikyiri,
na makɔtena serɛ so.
Anka mɛyɛ ntɛm madwane mafiri mframa kɛseɛ
ne ahum yi mu.
AWURADE, yɛ wɔn basabasa, paepae wɔn tɛkyerɛma mu,
na mahunu amimdie ne aperedie, kuro no mu.
Awia ne anadwo wɔnam
n’afasuo so twa ho hyia,
na amumuyɛ ne ɔhaw wɔ mu.
Amammɔsɛm wɔ mu,
na nhyɛsoɔ ne nnaadaa
mpa n’abɔntene so.
Na ɛnyɛ ɔtamfoɔ na ɔbɔ me ahohora,
ɛno deɛ, anka mɛtie.
Ɛnyɛ deɛ ɔkyiri me na ɔkyerɛ ne ho wɔ me soɔ,
anka mede me ho bɛhunta no.
Na wo dasani a me ne wo bɔ soɔ,
me yɔnko ne me manni,
wo a wo ne me di atirimusɛm dɛdɛ,
na yɛnam yɔɔ kɔ Nyankopɔn fie.
Ma owuo nto nsi wɔn so,
ma wɔnsiane nkɔ Asamando anikan,
na nsɛmmmɔne wɔ wɔn tenabea ne wɔn mu.
Me deɛ, mɛsu mafrɛ Onyankopɔn,
na AWURADE abɛgye me.
Anwummerɛ ne anɔpa ne awigyina
na mɛdwene me tirim na masi apini,
na ɔbɛte me nne.
Wagye me kra asomdwoeɛ mu,
na wɔammɛn me,
na wɔn a wɔne me anya dɔɔso.
Onyankopɔn bɛte na wabua wɔn.
Na ɔno na ɔte hɔ firi teteete.
Wɔn deɛ, wɔnsakyera,
nanso wɔnsuro Onyankopɔn.
Ɔtene ne nsa ne nnamfonom so,
wabu n’apam so.
N’anomu nsɛm yɛ fekɔɔ sene bɔta,
na ɔko wɔ n’akomam.
Ne nsɛm mu dwo bɛtɛɛ sene ngo,
nanso ɛyɛ mfena a wɔatwe.
Dane w’adesoa to AWURADE so,
na ɔbɛsɔ wo mu,
ɔremma ɔteneneeni
ntwe n’anan mu da.
Na wo, Onyankopɔn, wode wɔn
bɛkɔ ɔsɛeɛ amena mu,
mogyapɛfoɔ ne nnaadaafoɔ
renni wɔn nna fa,
na me deɛ, mede me ho meto wo so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
